children.name: If you had told me a few years ago that I would be dedicating my academic future to environmental science, I probably would have asked you what kind of bizarre alternate universe you crawled out of. After all, my journey into environmental studies isn’t rooted in a deep-seated love for getting my hands dirty. Rather, it stems from the visual pull of non-plastic campaigns, vibrant flower displays, and the undeniably scenic views of nature. This section explores my transition from a hesitant observer to an active investigator, highlighting my commitment to understanding, protecting, and designing solutions for the environment that sustain us.

Rather, it stems from the visual pull of non-plastic campaigns, vibrant flower displays, and the undeniably scenic views of nature.

This section explores my transition from a hesitant observer to an active investigator, highlighting my commitment to understanding, protecting, and designing solutions for the environment that sustain us.

children.name: Ban Mien - Ba Vi
children.text: Ban Mien - Ba Vi

children.name: During a community trip to Ban Mien, Ba Vi, I participated in a multifaceted sustainability and health initiative. Working alongside local residents, my peers and I explored traditional herbal medicine, studied their uses, and gained hands-on experience in the production and packaging process of those herbs. Additionally, I contributed to environmental restoration by planting trees and installing solar panels to provide reliable, clean energy access for the local community. Under the guidance of the commune’s residents, we were also involved in the production of a traditional cake - ‘Bánh Giò’. This immersive experience thoroughly deepened my understanding of the intersection of cultural heritage and sustainable development.

children.name: Collaborating with PhD. Nhung Nguyen, I investigated microbial mechanisms for remediation of heavy metals dyes, hydrocarbons, pharmaceuticals, and nutrient pollutants, focusing on biosorption, biodegradation, and biotransformation. In addition, we assessed environmental parameters, biosafety, and scalability, exploring AI, enzyme engineering, omics, and nanobiotechnology for sustainable bioremediation.

children.name: Arts
children.text: Arts

children.name: Art has been my constant language ever since I first learned how to hold a pen - long before Vietnamese, my native tongue, ever fully formed my spoken thoughts. Back in 2013, my go-to freetime routine consisted of a notebook, my favorite pencil, and a cranked up AC. What started as childhood doodles eventually evolved into a serious pursuit. I transitioned from casual sketching to investing in professional tools, studying countless tutorials, and committing to rigorous daily practice. Throughout high school, art became the anchor for my activities and social life, stretching beyond its simplest form of pen and paper. Today, it remains the driving force behind how I observe, interpret, and shape my experiences.
children.text:
Art has been my constant language ever since I first learned how to hold a pen - long before Vietnamese, my native tongue, ever fully formed my spoken thoughts. Back in 2013, my go-to freetime routine consisted of a notebook, my favorite pencil, and a cranked up AC.

What started as childhood doodles eventually evolved into a serious pursuit. I transitioned from casual sketching to investing in professional tools, studying countless tutorials, and committing to rigorous daily practice.

Throughout high school, art became the anchor for my activities and social life, stretching beyond its simplest form of pen and paper. Today, it remains the driving force behind how I observe, interpret, and shape my experiences.
